description: This file manages icon metadata for Thingsboard UI, fetching icon data from external sources, updating local icon bundles, and handling icon tags and synchronization between Material Icons and MDI icons.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes icon metadata by reading local JSON, updating with external icon data, and saving back.

methods.name: getMaterialIconMetadataAndUpdated
methods.description: Fetches Material Icons metadata from Google Fonts, filters and updates the local icon bundle.

methods.name: getMDIMetadataAndUpdated
methods.description: Reads MDI icon metadata, compares with local bundle, and updates tags and entries accordingly.

methods.name: findPreviousIcon
methods.description: Finds the index of a previous icon in the bundle by name.
